title: Air vs Earth at a wedding
caption:
Same wedding, two completely different nights.

Air hugs 40 people before reaching the table and leaves last. Earth arrives early, finds the quietest seat, and ate before coming, just in case (correctly: dinner came at 11pm). Traditionally they're the best pair: one brings the warmth, one brings the ground.

Tag your wedding buddy. Which one are they?
